parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under both `Examples/` and `WallpaperSampleApp/` in the directory hierarchy — a path-based sample-app-mirror signal that dominates the action signal regardless of the `is_sample_app: false` context flag. The canonical restraint pattern applies: one production method (`DebugMetricsProvider.measureCPUUsage` in package `DebugPanel`) and one sample-app copy (package `Wallpaper`, `DebugHUD.swift`). Consolidating these would couple the production `DebugPanel` package to demonstration semantics living inside the Wallpaper sample app, which is the wrong dependency direction. The correct resolution, if the duplication is unwanted, is to delete the copy in `DebugHUD.swift` and have the sample app import `DebugPanel` directly — not to extract to a shared location.
